gloss: to slip into; to crawl under; to sneak into

definitions.gloss: to crawl under; to slip into (a space)
definitions.explanation: To physically get under or inside something, such as a blanket, a bed, or a narrow space.
To enter a place secretly or without authorization.

examples.japanese: {布団|ふとん}に{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む。
{猫|ねこ}がベッドの{下|した}に{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The cat crawled under the bed.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}くて{毛布|もうふ}に{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}んで{出|で}たくない。
examples.english: It's so cold that I've burrowed into my blanket and don't want to come out.

examples.japanese: スパイが{組織|そしき}に{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}んだ。
コンサートにチケットなしで{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}もうとした。
examples.english: I tried to sneak into the concert without a ticket.

examples.japanese: {記者|きしゃ}が{身分|みぶん}を{隠|かく}して{工場|こうじょう}に{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The reporter concealed their identity and infiltrated the factory.

notes:
USAGE:
{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む is a compound verb combining {潜|もぐ}る (to dive, to go under) and {込|こ}む (into). The {込|こ}む suffix adds the nuance of going deep inside or fully entering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {布団|ふとん}に{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む (to slip into a futon)
- ベッドに{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む (to crawl into bed)
- {組織|そしき}に{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む (to infiltrate an organization)

CONJUGATION:
Godan verb (mu-row): {潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}まない / {潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}みます / {潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}んで
